packageRules.description: Keep action digest updates reviewable as one batch

Low-risk auto-merge: non-major updates to CI infrastructure Actions that PR CI fully exercises. Fail-closed allowlist; build tools (maturin-action, setup-uv, rust-toolchain) and the PyPI publish Action are excluded per the project brief, since differential tests miss wheel-tag/packaging/min-OS changes and the publish Action never runs in PR CI.
Keep Rust and Python dependency changes together for CI review
PyO3 pre-1.0 updates always require human review
